title: Neuroscience
identity: Cells, circuits and computation: biophysical models of neurons, systems-level organisation, and the computational models that make quantitative predictions. Synthetic teaching data is labelled as synthetic; real recordings are treated as real, with their noise and their limits.
conventions: A model is introduced with its assumptions and the data regime in which it was fit.
Fitting a model is not understanding it: explain why the model behaves as it does and where it fails.
